title: Fit derivation still duplicated in view_compute — the camera_fit 'ONE source' comment overclaims (r2 N1 only half-folded)
detail: r2 N1 said the triplication should become one source or the comment soften. camera_update now calls camera_fit, but view_compute still carries its own inline copy — two sources remain while the comment claims one.
recommended_fix: Move the fit helper into app/render (e.g. camera_fit in camera.odin taking win_w/win_h/world_w/world_h), call it from view_compute and app/main, or reword the comment to 'one source in app'.

title: touch.odin header still documents Pan as 'a deliberate no-op in the executor today' — the superseded 5.4 comment this job claims to have replaced
detail: types.odin's Pan comment and exec.odin were updated, and the PR body says 'The 5.4 Pan no-op comment is superseded by this story' — but touch.odin's header copy was missed and now contradicts the code.
recommended_fix: Update touch.odin's header to match types.odin: two-finger Pan routes to the app's on_pan camera effect (v2-camera-zoom).

title: cam_test_ctx heap-allocates the View with new(rnd.View) and never deletes it — the fixture frees every other buffer
evidence:
app/input/camera_input_test.odin:60:
	ictx.view = new(rnd.View)

app/input/input.odin:129-132 (the only teardown destroy performs):
destroy :: proc(inp: ^Input) {
	delete(inp.events)
	delete(inp.intents)
}

The tests defer destroy(&ictx), pp.run_destroy, pp.catalogs_destroy, delete(log) — no delete of the heap View (the fixture comment claims 'The caller owns every buffer (the exec_test pattern)').
detail: Every other fixture buffer is explicitly freed; the heap View (a large struct with embedded dynamic scratch) is leaked per test. No other app/input test uses new(...).
recommended_fix: Use a stack View owned by each test (view: rnd.View; ictx.view = &view) or add delete after destroy, matching the fixture's own ownership discipline.
